description:
Price range of a Wildberries / Ozon card pack in RUB; nothing is charged and nothing is started.

The planner chooses the slide count (3-12 here, 4 by default), so there is a range: cost_min_rub (1 photo, fewest
slides), cost_typical_rub (1 photo, 4 slides) and cost_max_rub (8 photos, 12 slides). The pack is charged once, at
its real price, when the plan is ready, and a pack that fails is refunded. A balance below cost_max_rub makes
create_marketplace_cards answer 402 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (tell the user to top up the balance). With a personal
discount the prices are the user's own and list_cost_*_rub are the price list.
name: estimate_marketplace_cards
